input.feature_set: exact frozen ordered 2,000 HVGs used by primary PCA and full-scale scVI calibration

optimization.initialization: fresh; do not resume from calibration model

training_duration.rule: exactly one complete epoch over the full production population
training_duration.coverage: every one of the 21,710,586 production cells contributes exactly once during the epoch

selection_rationale.f3_lr_0_005_advantage_over_f2_lr_0_003: weak but consistent in the matched near-optimal early region; descriptive only, not statistically conclusive with three seeds
selection_rationale.long_training_behavior: held-out validation negative ELBO worsened at 10,098 steps versus 8,898 for all six runs; 40,000-step endpoints were worse than per-run best checkpoints
selection_rationale.one_epoch_choice: conservative full-population stopping point; not claimed to be the exact validation-optimal checkpoint

change_control: Do not silently modify locked parameters. If an implementation problem requires a change, stop before production submission and create a versioned amendment documenting the reason, changed parameter, affected outputs, and required downstream regeneration. Preserve this lock as the original decision record.

required_before_training_submission: run-specific configuration reviewed against an approved scale/performance benchmark
